title: Step 3 - Text Cleaning for NLP: Remove Punctuation and Convert to Lowercase

cues.en: -: All right.
Are you ready to do some cleaning?

cues.zh: 目前有標點、字母以外的字元。

The verbs are conjugated differently.

cues.en: We need to clean the text as much as we can in order to ease the learning process of the future machine learning model, which we will train to understand the reviews,

cues.en: understand English, basically, and predict if the reviews are positive or negative.

cues.en: So re.

cues.zh: 就是文字清理後，不想納入評論的詞，對預測

cues.en: of whether a review is positive or negative.
And these words include, you know, the simple ones like "the", you know.
All the articles like "the", "er", "end", you know.
cues.zh: 冠詞像 the、a，還有 and 之類。

cues.en: All these words which don't give any hint of whether a review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 這些詞不提供正面或負面線索。

cues.en: So we will remove all these words, you know.
All the words that are not helpful to predict if a review is positive or negative.

cues.en: Okay? So.
Good.

cues.en: Well, we're gonna import a class which is the PorterStemmer class.
Perfect.
And this is the class we'll use, of course, to apply stemming on our reviews.
cues.zh: 當然用它對評論進行詞幹提取。

cues.en: So now let me remind what this is about.
Stemming consists of taking only the root of a word that indicates enough about what this word means.
cues.zh: 詞幹提取，只保留足以說明詞義的根部。

cues.en: So for example. Let's say there is a review that says, "Oh, I loved this restaurant."
cues.zh: 例如評論說：「我很喜歡這家餐廳。」英文用 loved。

cues.en: Okay? And let's say we want to apply stemming to the word "loved".
cues.zh: 假設對 loved 做詞幹提取。

cues.en: Well, what it will do is that it will transform loved into love.
cues.zh: 會把 loved 轉成 love。

cues.en: Just to simplify the review.
Because whether we say, "Oh, I loved this restaurant."
cues.zh: 因為說 I loved this restaurant，

cues.en: or "Oh, I love this restaurant."
Well, you know, that means the same.
That means that the review is positive.
So we can totally remove all the conjugation of the verbs, you know. Just keeping the present tense so that we can indeed simplify the reviews.
cues.zh: 所以可以移除動詞變化，只留現在式，簡化評論。

cues.en: Because remember at the end, you know, after cleaning the text when creating actually the bag of words model, we will create a sparse matrix where in each column we will have all the different words
cues.zh: 記得清理後，建立詞袋時會建稀疏矩陣，每欄是所有評論中的不同詞，

cues.en: of all our different reviews.
And therefore, in order to optimize or you know, minimize the dimension of this sparse matrix, where the dimension is exactly the number of columns.
cues.zh: 為最佳化、最小化稀疏矩陣維度，而維度正是欄數，

cues.en: Well, we need to simplify as much as we can the words.
And if we don't apply stemming, well, you know, in the sparse matrix, we will have one column for love and one column for loved.
cues.zh: 不做詞幹提取，矩陣就會有 love 一欄、loved 一欄。

cues.en: And since that means the same thing, that would be redundant.
And that would make the sparse matrix even more complex.
You know, with a higher dimension.
So that would be wrong.
So that's exactly what stemming is about.
cues.zh: 這正是詞幹提取的目的。

cues.en: It consists of reducing the final dimension of the sparse matrix so that we can indeed have not too much trouble to learn the text from our machine learning model.
cues.zh: 降低最終稀疏矩陣維度，讓模型學習文字不會太困難。

cues.en: All right.
So that's what this PorterStemmer class will do.
And now, there you go my friend.
We can start cleaning the text.
We have all the tools we need.
So the first thing we'll do is create a new list which we'll call corpus.
All right.
And we will initialize this list as an empty list.
And what will this list be exactly?
You know, what will it contain?
Well, it will simply contain all our different reviews.
You know, all the different reviews from our data set but all cleaned and all into this list corpus.
cues.zh: 資料集中各評論清理過後，全放進 corpus。

cues.en: So what we'll do actually is, you know, we will make a for loop to iterate through all the different reviews of our data set.
cues.zh: 用 for 迴圈走遍資料集的每則評論。

cues.en: And for each of these review, we will apply a cleaning process, you know, by putting all the letters in lower case and removing the punctuations and removing the stop words.
cues.zh: 逐則清理，例如轉小寫、移除標點、移除停用詞。

cues.en: All these things.
And we will do that one review after another.
And each time we clean a review.
Well, we will add it to this corpus.
So this corpus will only get in the end, all the cleaned reviews. Okay?
cues.zh: 最後只包含所有清理後的評論。

cues.en: And we do this, of course, because then the future functions we'll use in the next steps expect our reviews in the list and all cleans. Okay?
cues.zh: 因為下一步的函式，要求評論放在串列，而且清理完成。

cues.en: So corpus. And now.
Now that we initialized this list.
Well, we're gonna populate it with the clean reviews through a for loop.
cues.zh: 透過 for 迴圈填入乾淨評論。

cues.en: A for loop, which will iterate, you know, with this classic looping variable i in the range from 0 to.
cues.zh: 用慣用變數 i，範圍從 0 到，

cues.en: Well, guess what?
Guess what is the upper bound?
You know, we will simply iterate through all the reviews.
And since we have 1000 reviews in our data set.
Well, i will simply go from 0 to 1000, right?
cues.zh: 所以 i 的 range 從 0 到 1,000。

cues.en: As simple as that.
It will iterate through the indexes of the reviews, which go effectively from 0 to 999.
cues.zh: 實際走過評論索引 0 到 999。

cues.en: Okay?
So, for loop ready.
And now we can go inside the for loop.
And there we go.
Now we're gonna apply different steps to clean each and every single review of our data sets.

cues.en: So first of all, we will create a new variable, which we will call review.
And that variable will exactly be that cleaned review.
But, you know, we will clean it step by step.
So we'll update review each time we proceed to a new kind of cleaning.
cues.zh: 每做新一種清理，就更新 review。

cues.en: And the first kind of cleaning we'll do will be to remove all punctuations.
In other words, it'll be to keep only the letters in our reviews.
All right?
And to do this, we're gonna call our re library from which we're gonna call the subfunction, which is a function that can replace anything
cues.zh: 呼叫 re 的 sub 函式，可以把文字裡任何內容，

cues.en: in a text, you know.
In a string actually by anything else you want.
cues.zh: 字串中，替換成想要的其他內容。

cues.en: And what we're gonna replace, actually, is any element that is not a letter, you know, from A to Z, by a space.
cues.zh: 要替換任何不是 A 到 Z 字母的元素，改成空格。

cues.en: So that every punctuation, like quotes, double quotes, comas or columns or anything you want will be replaced by a space, and it has to be replaced by a space.
cues.zh: 所有標點，例如單引號、雙引號、逗號、冒號等等，都改空格，而且一定要空格。

cues.en: Because otherwise we can have two words that stick together.
cues.zh: 否則可能兩個詞黏在一起。

cues.en: So we need to make sure we replace the punctuations by spaces so that we can indeed still separate the words.
cues.zh: 必須用空格替換標點，才能繼續分開各詞。

cues.en: All right.
And the way to do this, thanks to this subfunction is to enter here in the parameters.
cues.zh: 透過 sub 的做法，是在參數輸入，

cues.en: First, what we want to replace.
And the trick to say that we want to replace anything that is not a letter, is to do it this way.
cues.zh: 表示「任何非字母」的技巧如下。

cues.en: You start with a pair of square brackets here.
Just like that.
So that what's inside this pair of square brackets will be what will be replaced, you know, by the spaces.
cues.zh: 裡面的內容會被空格替換。

cues.en: And the trick to say that what we want to replace are anything but letters is to include a ^ here.
cues.zh: 要說除了字母外都替換，就在裡面加 ^。

cues.en: And I will explain what this means.
And then add A.
So you have to do it like that, actually. ^^A.
Okay?
A-Z.
So all the lowercase letters from a to z.
cues.zh: 所有 a 到 z 小寫。

cues.en: But also then all the capital letters from A to Z.
cues.zh: 再加 A 到 Z 大寫。

cues.en: All right?
And what this ^ means is exactly not, you know.
This symbol in mathematics or computer science means not.
cues.zh: 在數學或電腦科學，這符號代表非。

cues.en: Meaning not all the letters from a to z in lowercase nor the capital letters from A to Z which is exactly what we want.
cues.zh: 表示不是小寫 a 到 z，也不是大寫 A 到 Z，正是我們要的。

cues.en: We want to replace anything that is not the letters from A to Z in lowercase or capitals by spaces.
cues.zh: 把非大小寫 A 到 Z 字母的東西，都換空格。

cues.en: And the way to specify that we want to replace all these by spaces is well exactly what we have to enter here as a second parameter.
cues.zh: 怎麼指定換空格？就是第二個參數。

cues.en: And which we will enter in, you know, quotes, but inside a space, right?
cues.zh: 加引號，裡面放一個空格。

cues.en: What's inside these quotes is exactly what we want to replace those non-letters here by.
cues.zh: 引號裡正是要把非字母換成的內容。

cues.en: All right?
So we're gonna replace everything that is not letters meaning all the punctuations by this space.
cues.zh: 所以非字母，也就是標點，都換這個空格。

cues.en: Okay? And then finally, we have to enter one final argument, which is of course, where we want to do all these replacements.
cues.zh: 最後再一個引數，當然是在哪裡做替換。

cues.en: You know, inside the what.
Inside which review, right?
Inside which text.
And so very simply, the third parameter we have to enter here is the review in which we want to do all these replacements.
cues.zh: 所以第三參數，是要替換的評論。

iloc works very well too.

Well, of course.

The one of index i.

cues.en: And that's exactly what we want.
All right.
First cleaning done.
Now we will proceed to two other types of cleaning.
Then we will take a little break and then we will proceed to stemming, which will consist of, you know, simplifying the words in order to get only the root
cues.zh: 然後稍休息，再詞幹提取，簡化詞只保留根部，

cues.en: and therefore simplifying eventually the sparse matrix.
All right. So that new step will be to transform all the capital letters into lowercase.

To do this, we just need to take our review variable from which we can now call a specific function.

You just have to enter it like that.
review.lower.
But this will return the review with only lowercase letters.
cues.zh: 傳回只有小寫字母的評論。

cues.en: And since we want to update our review variable where we simply need to add here review equals, right?
cues.zh: 要更新 review，只需加上 review 等於。

cues.en: Equals the result of applying the lower function to our previous version of the review.
cues.zh: 等於對上一版 review 套 lower 的結果。

cues.en: Okay? So very easy.
And then one final cleaning before we proceed to stemming in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一堂詞幹提取前，最後再做一項。

cues.en: Well, actually, what we have to do now is something to prepare for the stemming and that's something is to split the different elements of the reviews in different words.
cues.zh: 其實是準備詞幹提取，把評論元素分割成不同詞。

cues.zh: 因為現在不同元素都是詞。

cues.zh: 把評論拆成詞，接著才能逐詞提取詞幹，以根部簡化。

cues.en: Okay? So the way to do this is very simple.
Once again, you know, I'm gonna copy this and paste that here.

As simple as that.
